title: Maroon 5 performs in São Paulo on Love Is Like tour
seoTitle: Maroon 5 São Paulo: Setlist, Access & Tour Details
subtitle: Adam Levine-led band plays Nubank Parque with a setlist focused on classic hits
excerpt: Maroon 5 performs in São Paulo on Tuesday at Nubank Parque. See the likely setlist, opening times, and access rules for the Love Is Like tour show.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Maroon 5 performs this Tuesday, the 8th, at Nubank Parque in São Paulo, as part of the "Love Is Like World Tour." The band, fronted by vocalist Adam Levine, brings a repertoire that prioritizes their biggest career hits, as observed in previous stops of the tour in Latin America.

Repertoire strategy focused on classics

Although the tour is named "Love Is Like," the setlist presented in Latin America has concentrated efforts on well-known hits, setting aside songs from the self-titled album. Up until the performance in São José do Rio Preto, held on Sunday, the 6th, no songs from the new album had appeared in the record of the Latin American leg. The strategy is guided by nostalgia, following the pattern of recent performances, including a show in São Paulo in December 2025.

Times and opening acts

Gate opening at Nubank Parque is scheduled for 4:00 PM. The band from Minas Gerais, Lagum, is responsible for the opening act, with a performance scheduled for 8:30 PM, preceding Maroon 5's entrance on stage. The estimated audience for the night is 35,000 people, which requires a special traffic and transportation operation in the Água Branca area.

Logistics and transportation for the event

Using public transport is recommended due to the high volume of pedestrians and vehicles. The nearest station is Palmeiras-Barra Funda, served by the 3-Red Line of the Metro and by CPTM. CET (Traffic Engineering Company) will implement blockades and detours on streets such as Palestra Itália, Diana, Caraíbas, and at the intersection of Rua Padre Antônio Tomás with Avenida Francisco Matarazzo. Taxi drivers will have specific drop-off points starting at 10:00 PM, while sections of Avenida Sumaré and Avenida Antártica have been designated for ride-hailing services.

Access rules and permitted items

The complex does not provide locker services, and all spectators will undergo security checks. Small portable chargers (up to 500g), individually packaged sealed industrialized food, and transparent flexible plastic cups with water (maximum 600 ml, no lid) are allowed. Bags and backpacks must have maximum dimensions of 30 cm x 15 cm x 20 cm. Non-professional compact cameras, fans, and hand-held fans are also authorized.

Prohibited items and age rating

Rigid bottles, thermal cups, alcoholic beverages, umbrellas, selfie sticks, football team jerseys, electronic smoking devices, and professional filming equipment are prohibited. Backpacks larger than 30 cm x 15 cm x 20 cm, helmets, skateboards, weapons, and fireworks are also not allowed. The event is rated 16+, requiring the presence of a legal guardian for minors.

With information from Exame, VEJA SÃO PAULO.
